<div class="card-body">
'''DS-61-3''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ＤＳ－６１－３</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼の操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋３。ブラック３に乗っている場合、回避値＋１となる上に、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、１枚引ける。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">パイロットＤＳ－６１－３号。ブラック３を駆り、ベイダー機との編隊で右翼を務める。獰猛な戦闘で知られる、非常に優れたコレリア人のパイロット。別名“不意打ちする者”。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' DS-61-3.

'''Card text:''' Any starship he pilots is power +3. While aboard Black 3, maneuver is +1, and he may draw one battle destiny even if otherwise unable to draw one.

'''Lore:''' Pilot DS-61-3. He flies Black 3 as the right wingman in formation with Vader's craft. A highly skilled Corellian pilot known for ferocity in combat. Also known as “one who strikes by surprise.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese nickname means “one who strikes by surprise”; the English calls him “Backstabber.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[DS-61-3]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=147s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:27.</ref>
